name: Stupulag

abilities.name: Strike/Flaming Fists
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing high physical damage (Strike) then dealing one tick of minor direct flame damage (Flaming Fists).

abilities.name: Flaming Retreat
abilities.description: Stupulag jumps backwards, leaving an area that explodes after a small delay, dealing moderate-high flame damage.

abilities.name: Searing Gurge/Explosive Gurge
abilities.description: Stupulag steps back then spits fire areas traveling forward 5 times, each one dealing moderate-high flame damage (Searing Gurge). Each time one area hits, it creates a burst of flames under the target dealing moderate-high flame damage in an area (Explosive Gurge).

abilities.name: Hot Shot/Hot Shot Splash
abilities.description: Stupulag shoots a ball of fire straight at his target, dealing moderate flame damage (Hot Shot). Creates "Hot Shot Splash" on impact which is a ground flaming area dealing very fast ticks of minor direct flame damage.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: If low on health, Stupulag starts beating on its chest to heal itself up at a rate of 0,2% of its Max Health (6,215) for the first tick, each subsequent tick increasing by that amount, for 5 ticks in total. This can be interrupted to stagger Stupulag.

summary: Stupulag is an ogrim who can found in a northern room, near a furnace with Gujelag. He serves as one of the champions of the Gorne public dungeon.
